jobs.title: AIRNEX - Affiliate Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Ready to build a high-performing affiliate programme for a sustainable brand?
Own recruitment, partnerships, and revenue growth across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok, and more.

$2,500-$3,500/month | Full-time | Flexible hours, CEST meetings

Click here to watch the video from the founder of AIRNEX.

AIRNEX is a fast-growing multi-channel brand creating sustainable consumer products that help people make better everyday choices. Our mission is simple: help people make small, meaningful changes that add up to a big impact for the planet. We're passionate about sustainability and love working with people who share that passion.

We're growing fast, and our products are now sold on marketplaces like Amazon and Walmart, as well as our web store, and in 500+ brick-and-mortar stores. 

We're a small, talented team expanding globally, and we are seeking a dedicated, results-driven Affiliate Marketing Manager to build and manage AIRNEX's affiliate program. You’ll oversee the entire affiliate lifecycle: from recruiting and onboarding partners to driving measurable conversions and revenue growth.

See the current Airnex Team below:

We're looking for an Affiliate Marketing Manager. We need someone who is results-driven, highly responsive, and strong at building relationships - someone who can take full ownership of our affiliate programme and turn it into a measurable revenue driver. You'll manage the entire affiliate lifecycle across Amazon Creator Connections, Shopify, TikTok Shop, and external affiliate networks. Your responsibilities include:

📋 Manage and expand AIRNEX affiliate programmes on Amazon, Shopify, TikTok, and affiliate networks

💡 Work on the long-term strategy and KPIs with the Marketing Manager

🎯 Launch campaigns, promotions, and incentive programmes to increase affiliate engagement and revenue

🤝 Prospect, reach out, and recruit potential affiliates and influencers

💻 Negotiate and manage partnerships to ensure consistent growth in qualified leads and conversions

📞 Build strong relationships through consistent communication (all affiliate communications should receive a response within 24 hours)

📊 Provide weekly performance reports, analyse results, and suggest improvements

Flexible working hours with meetings in CEST - work overlaps with USA time zones.

Requirements

To be successful in this role, you need:

✅ Proven experience managing and building e-commerce affiliate programmes

✅ Strong understanding of CPA, CPL, revenue share, and other performance-based models

✅ Strong knowledge of Amazon Affiliate Network (Amazon Creator Connections, Amazon Associates, etc.)

✅ TikTok Shop and TikTok Affiliate Programme familiarity

✅ Familiarity with affiliate networks (eg. Commission Junction, CJ Affiliate, etc)

✅ Analytical skills to filter raw data, spot trends and patterns, and get actionable insights

✅ Available full-time - no concurrent freelance or external jobs

✅ Close to native English verbal and written skills

✅ Impeccable work ethic and professional attitude

Brownie points for:

⭐ Experience managing TikTok Shop influencers

⭐ Passion for sustainability

The ideal candidate is dedicated and proactive, someone who can independently manage their work, improve SOPs, and lead process improvement. This person takes ownership of results, thrives on solving problems without waiting to be told what to do, and communicates clearly and professionally with partners. Strong relationship-building skills matter here - affiliates and influencers need regular follow-up, support, and feedback to perform well, and you'll be the person they rely on.

Benefits

What’s in it for you?

💰 $2,500-$3,500 USD per month*

💼 Full-time

🌍 Fully remote

⏰ Flexible working hours with meetings in CEST - work overlaps with USA time zones

🚀 Opportunity to work in a fast-growing purpose-driven international brand

📚 Reimbursement of up to 1 personal development / business book per month

📈 Internal progression - tell us what else you like to do, and we'll provide mentorship

💵 Quarterly performance bonuses

*Please note that this is a gross salary and that you are responsible for any tax-related procedures in your country of residence. We kindly ask you to apply only if you are happy to work remotely as an independent contractor.

This is our typical hiring process - occasionally, it may include extra steps.

For this role, JobRack is partnering with the company to find their next hire. We’ll handle all the screening and testing, so they see only the best-fit candidates - like you!

🔍 How to shine
• Read the role details carefully.
• Submit a thoughtful, high-quality application.
• Stay responsive - we’ll keep you updated at every stage.

✨ Important notes
• Apply only through JobRack; please don’t contact the company directly.
• We expect a respectful hiring experience - any disrespect means instant disqualification.
• This is a full-time, primary role (no freelancing or second jobs).

❓ New to remote work?
